'''Task Force ''Admonitor''''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Task force/Legends|task force]] [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanded]] by [[Captain of the Line/Legends|Senior Captain]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]]. It was named after its commanding [[Star Destroyer/Legends|vessel]], the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Admonitor]]''. [[0 ABY/Legends|Eight months]] after [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|battle of Yavin]] the task force was involved in battle between Thrawn and an [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] named [[Nuso Esva]]. When Thrawn was temporarily away from his ship, the task force was commanded by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Voss Parck/Legends|Voss Parck]].

==Description==
Besides the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Admonitor]]'', the task force had several support ships. At least four [[Carrack-class light cruiser/Legends|''Carrack''-class light cruisers]] served in the force, as well as two [[Strike-class medium cruiser|''Strike''-class medium cruisers]].<ref name="Choices of One" />

During the [[Battle of the Poln system|battle of the]] [[Poln system/Legends|Poln system]], the task force was bolstered by five [[Heavy cruiser/Legends|heavy cruisers]], and three [[Light cruiser/Legends|light cruisers]], all of which were of unknown alien configuration.<ref name="Choices of One" />

[[Specter Squadron (Imperial)|Specter Squadron]],<ref name="Command Decision" /> and [[Gray Squadron (Empire of the Hand)|Gray Squadron]]<ref name="Crisis of Faith" /> were [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] based on the ''Admonitor''.

==History==
The earliest known use for the group was [[0 ABY/Legends|eight months]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|battle of Yavin]]. Thrawn had been driven into a conflict with [[Nuso Esva|Nuso Evsa]], who held a [[Nuso Esva's realm|vast empire]] and was a skilled manipulator. Thrawn placed [[Commanding officer/Legends|command]] of the force to [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Voss Parck/Legends|Voss Parck]], while he went to have a meeting with the Emperor onboard the half completed [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]]. Thrawn requested at least six [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]] as reinforcements for him to counter the Evsa' [[Firekiln]]s. Palpatine couldn't spare any more ships, as a majority of them were tasked with hunting down the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|rebel fleet]]. However, Palpatine convinced Thrawn to speak to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], as he controlled [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]]. Meanwhile, sometime during this meeting, Parck engaged Evsa's [[Eastern Fleet]] [[Engagement at Teptixii|at]] [[Teptixii|Tepitxii]]. The battle seem to have been lost, if not for the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']] arriving to assist. Thanks to the ''Chimaera''{{'s}} untimely arrival, Parck was able win the battle against the Eastern [[Fleet/Legends|Fleet]].<ref name="Choices of One" />

However, before he could destroy anymore ships, the fleet [[Hyperspace/Legends|jumped]], heading to the [[Poln system/Legends|Poln system]]. The task force tracked them to the Poln system, and followed them there. Little did they know, the star system was being used as a trap by Evsa. By the time they arrived, they were [[Battle of the Poln system|attacked]] by the Eastern Fleet. Out [[Space warfare/Legends|gunned]], and surrounded, defeat was inevitable. Thrawn would have had his career humiliated, and Evsa would have gained new territory for his empire. Not only that, but the ''Chimaera'' was on a collision with a [[Golan I Space Defense Platform/Legends|Golan I defense platform]], but [[Jorj Car'das]] and Thrawn used the ''[[Lost Reef]]'' and ''Chimaera''{{'s}} remaining [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam systems]] to steer the seriously damaged ship away from the orbital battle station. This ruined Evsa's battle plan, but he still proceeded to his ultimate victory. But, Thrawn revealed his surprise: Death Squadron. The [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']], backed by several [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] including; [[Avenger/Legends|''Avenger'']], ''[[Stalker/Legends|Stalker]]'', [[Devastator/Legends|''Devastator'']], [[Rebel Dream|''Tyrant'']], ''[[Emancipator|Accuser]]'', [[Liberator (Imperial I-class)|''Adjudicator'']]. Thrawn temporarily gave command of his task force to Vader, and the battle was won, and Evsa's Eastern Fleet was decimated, pushing back his plans.<ref name="Choices of One" />
